selectionMethod: Review article slugs, content clusters, learning/interview links and primary-source search results. No keyword volume, ranking-difficulty or traffic forecast is invented. No new visitor tracking.

selected.gap: No dedicated source-checked Go job-market and application-cohort guide. Existing popularity article covers rankings, not employment outcomes.
selected.distinctValue: Actual public Go-filtered Djinni widget evidence, careful denominator and pay-unit distinctions, original selection-bias calculation and practical preparation links.

selected.gap: No dedicated exact-error troubleshooting article across context, HTTP client, SQL waiting and gRPC status. Existing pool, HTTP and backpressure articles cover narrower adjacent boundaries.
selected.distinctValue: Network-free controlled transports, virtual-time tests, cancellation-versus-join demonstration, four negative controls and a downloadable lab.

SEOImplementation: Descriptive titles and original 2000+ word prose
Canonical URL, description, keywords, Open Graph/Twitter and TechArticle metadata
Three distinct generated illustrations per article with descriptive alt text
Reciprocal article links and links to real course/interview IDs
News archive, RSS and image sitemap discovery
measurementLimits: Search eligibility and useful content are checked; index inclusion, ranking and traffic growth are not guaranteed. Evaluate aggregate Search Console data after crawl, without adding product telemetry.
